title: Desk Guidance on the Mortgage Loan File: Offsetting Recent Credit Report Charges Against the Application Fee
content:
Recent credit report fee charges on a Mortgage Loan File are offset against the file's application fee. The charges read are the credit report fee charges booked on the same file's fee ledger less than 6 whole months before the collection date; the borrowers they cover are the borrowers pulled recorded on those charges, added together.

**Rule.** Where the credit report fee charges booked on the file less than 6 whole months before the collection date cover at least as many borrowers as the file now has, the booked amount of those charges, whatever it is (a 0.00 charge included), is taken off; where such recent charges cover fewer borrowers than the file now has, the program's credit report fee per borrower (as listed in the Larkspur program fee schedule) is taken off for each borrower they cover; where the file has no credit report fee charge in that period nothing is taken off.

A charge is less than 6 whole months old where the collection date falls before the same day of the sixth month after its booking date.

## Worked cases (hypothetical file now having 2 borrowers; per-borrower credit report fee 92.40 USD)

| Recent credit report fee charges on the file | Borrowers covered | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| one charge of 184.80 USD covering 2 borrowers, booked 2 months ago | 2 — at least the 2 on the file | 184.80 USD, the booked amount |
| one charge of 150.00 USD covering 2 borrowers, booked 5 months ago | 2 | 150.00 USD, the booked amount |
| one charge of 92.40 USD covering 1 borrower, booked 1 month ago | 1 — fewer than 2 | 92.40 USD for the one borrower covered |
| one charge of 0.00 USD covering 2 borrowers, booked 3 months ago | 2 | 0.00 USD, the booked amount |
| one charge booked 7 months ago | none within the period | nothing |
